answer: Use synchronized route proofs. First, issue each entrant a random route through three staffed checkpoints: the jetty, the terrace and the karst trail. Second, require a signed NFC tap plus a fresh face match at each stop within 20 minutes. Third, publish only blinded receipts and reject overlapping routes tied to the same face. With checkpoints 10 minutes apart, one runner can service only one identity per round; 100 identities need 100 runners, costing $2,000 at $20 each. It is a turnstile stretched across a landscape: extra tickets still need extra legs.
